notes: Canonical TARGET-20/21 6-character USI or biospecimen-suffix extension mapped to that USI.
2354 GDC cases map to 2315 persons; extra cases are biospecimen-suffix duplicates, not exclusions.
Primary eligibility: age_at_diagnosis_days / 365.25 < 18. Not chosen to maximize N.
Unknown / Not Reported / missing vital status excluded, not censored.
Dead requires days_to_death >= 0; Alive requires days_to_last_follow_up >= 0.
